It reports 231,733.710375 USDC and 8,082,639.81 USDG, total 8,314,373.520375 nominal dollar units, with zero PYUSD and USDT reported in that selected account scope. Normalization of the two positive balances yields 2.78714578% USDC and 97.21285422% USDG. The rendered issuer dashboard exposes the same source presentation, rounded to 2.79% and 97.21%, with displayed USDv supply 8,314,324.72. This is a current issuer-reported selected-account composition, not a fresh pinned chain observation or independent corroboration. The dashboard's 100% backing label does not resolve assets at approved external destinations, complete economic obligations, or legal reserve segregation. The earlier September 15 on-chain observation remains historical and does not supply this review's current clock. No full-composition or financial-assurance admission is claimed.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The observed stablecoins are controlled by the Chancery reserve-authority PDA 8anxfyoftY9hPwxdvReet2beFS2HXjcXraPEamo4nGyB. Program source characterizes reserve compartments as operator-side controls, not customer escrow, FBO, trust or beneficial ownership records. Upgrades are controlled by a separate 3-of-8-member Squads multisig with a two-day delay; live operational and treasury roles have single-signature quorums. No new-token off-chain custodian, legal segregation, bankruptcy remoteness or rehypothecation restriction is verified. Circle/Paxos upstream custody is carried through the collateral dependencies, not claimed as direct custody of USDv holders.
